tests.title: Login with valid seeded credentials returns a usable bearer token
tests.objective: Parents can authenticate and use the returned token on protected endpoints.
tests.risk: If login or token issuance breaks, no parent can view or pay fees.
preconditions: Backend running at API_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1) with dev endpoints enabled (APP_ENV=development).
Any database state (seed data present).
steps: POST auth/login with body {"email": TEST_USER_EMAIL, "password": TEST_USER_PASSWORD}.
Record access_token and expires_at from the response.
GET auth/me with header Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.
expectedResults: Step 1: HTTP 200; body has non-empty access_token, token_type == "Bearer", expires_at is a future ISO-8601 timestamp (≈120 minutes ahead with default TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES).
Step 1: parent == {id: "par_001", email: "thandi.mokoena@example.com", full_name: "Thandi Mokoena"} (phone present).
Step 3: HTTP 200 and body equals the parent object returned by login.
Every response carries an X-Request-ID header.

tests.title: Invalid credentials and malformed login bodies are rejected
tests.objective: Login rejects wrong passwords, unknown users and invalid input with the documented errors.
tests.risk: Weak credential handling or leaky error messages are a security risk; wrong status codes break clients.
preconditions: Backend running at API_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1) with dev endpoints enabled (APP_ENV=development).
steps: POST auth/login with the correct email and password "wrong-password".
POST auth/login with email nobody@example.com and any password.
POST auth/login with {"email": "not-an-email", "password": "x"}.
POST auth/login with {"email": TEST_USER_EMAIL} (password missing).
expectedResults: Steps 1–2: HTTP 401, error.code == "INVALID_CREDENTIALS", error.message == "Invalid email or password." (identical for unknown user and wrong password – no user enumeration); no access_token in body.
Step 3: HTTP 422, error.code == "VALIDATION_ERROR", error.details contains {location: "body", field: "email", message: "Enter a valid email address."}.
Step 4: HTTP 422 VALIDATION_ERROR with a details entry for field "password".
All error bodies match {error: {code, message, details, request_id}}.

tests.title: Protected endpoints reject missing, invalid and revoked tokens
tests.objective: Fee and payment data are only accessible with a valid, unrevoked token.
tests.risk: Unauthenticated access to children's fee and payment data.
preconditions: Backend running at API_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1) with dev endpoints enabled (APP_ENV=development).
steps: GET fees/outstanding with no Authorization header.
GET fees/outstanding with Authorization: Bearer invalid-token-123.
Log in (POST auth/login) and GET fees/outstanding with the new token.
POST auth/logout with that token.
GET fees/outstanding again with the same (now revoked) token.
expectedResults: Step 1: HTTP 401, error.code == "UNAUTHORIZED", response header WWW-Authenticate: Bearer.
Step 2: HTTP 401, error.code == "INVALID_TOKEN".
Step 3: HTTP 200.
Step 4: HTTP 204 with empty body.
Step 5: HTTP 401, error.code == "INVALID_TOKEN".

tests.title: A parent cannot read or pay another parent's students, fees or payments
tests.objective: Ownership checks isolate each parent's data and return 404 (no existence leak).
tests.risk: Broken object-level authorisation (BOLA/IDOR) would expose or allow paying other families' fees.

tests.title: Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the original payment
tests.objective: Retries of a create request never create a second payment.
tests.risk: Duplicate charges when clients retry after timeouts or double-clicks.
preconditions: Backend running at API_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1) with dev endpoints enabled (APP_ENV=development).
testData: Dedicated account loadtest050@example.com (seeded password, root README §6). Fees: Term 3 Tuition (balance 50 000 000 cents, currently fee_1170), Term 3 Transport (10 000 000, fee_1171), Annual Excursions (5 000 000, fee_1172). Resolve IDs via GET /fees/outstanding rather than hard-coding them.
Body {"fee_id": <Term 3 Tuition id>, "amount_cents": 10000, "payment_method": "CARD"}; one fixed UUID key.
steps: Log in as loadtest050; note GET transactions?fee_id={feeId} total (T0).
POST payments with key K and the body.
POST payments again with the same key K and identical body.
GET transactions?fee_id={feeId}.
expectedResults: Step 2: HTTP 201.
Step 3: HTTP 200 with header Idempotent-Replayed: true; body.id and body.reference equal step 2's.
Step 4: total == T0 + 1 (exactly one payment created).

tests.title: Reusing an Idempotency-Key with a different body is rejected

tests.risk: A key reused with a different amount could silently return the wrong payment or create a mismatched charge.
preconditions: Backend running at API_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1) with dev endpoints enabled (APP_ENV=development).

Key K (new UUID); original amount 10 000; conflicting amount 20 000 (same fee).
steps: Log in as loadtest050 and resolve the Term 3 Tuition fee id.
POST payments with key K and amount_cents 10000; record payment id P.
POST payments with the same key K and amount_cents 20000.
GET transactions?fee_id={feeId}&page_size=100.

Step 3: HTTP 422, error.code == "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED", error.details.payment_id == P.
Step 4: no payment with amount_cents 20000 exists for this key; P still has amount_cents 10000.

tests.title: Concurrent duplicate create requests produce exactly one payment

tests.title: Gateway timeout returns 504, blocks new payments for the fee, then settles as FAILED
tests.objective: Unknown gateway outcomes are held in PROCESSING and reconciled; concurrent payments on the same fee are blocked meanwhile.
tests.risk: Double charging while an outcome is unknown, or payments stuck forever in PROCESSING.
preconditions: Backend running at API_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1) with dev endpoints enabled (APP_ENV=development).
Simulation shortened in setup: PUT dev/simulation {"gateway_timeout_ms": 500, "pending_resolution_seconds": 2}; restore with DELETE dev/simulation in teardown.
testData: Account loadtest049@example.com (avoid colliding with other tests), Term 3 Transport fee.
steps: Create a payment (1 000 cents) and confirm with the timeout card; measure duration.
Immediately GET payments/{id}/status.
POST a new payment for the same fee (new key).
Wait 2.5 s, then GET payments/{id}/status and GET payments/{id}.
expectedResults: Step 1: HTTP 504 after ≥ 500 ms; error.code "GATEWAY_TIMEOUT", details.status "PROCESSING", details.retry_after_ms 1000.
Step 2: status "PROCESSING", is_final false, retry_after_ms 1000.
Step 3: HTTP 409, error.code "PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS", details.payment_id == the processing payment.
Step 4: status "FAILED", failure_code "GATEWAY_TIMEOUT", is_final true; events include GATEWAY_TIMEOUT then PAYMENT_FAILED; fee not credited.
